final_text:
I found the account: **Marcus Hill** (marcus.hill@harborpointdental.test), Dental Hygienist, Clinical — currently an active, licensed user mailbox (Microsoft 365 Business Basic).

Before you approve, two things worth knowing:

1. **Marcus loses his working mailbox.** A shared mailbox can't be signed into the way a user mailbox can. If Marcus is still an active employee using this email day to day, this will disrupt him — this change is normally done when someone has left the practice.
2. **Converting first, then removing the license.** Shared mailboxes don't need a license, so once the conversion is done I'd recommend removing his Microsoft 365 Business Basic license to free up that seat. I'll only do that after the conversion succeeds, since removing it first would disconnect the mailbox and break the conversion.

Also, converting alone won't give you access — I can grant you Full Access afterward so you can keep reading it in Outlook. Just say the word and I'll walk through the access type options.
